faq.q: What is the origin of Aamir?
faq.a: Aamir is associated with Arabic. Active participle of عَمَرَ (to inhabit, to flourish). Distinct from أمير (amīr, commander).
Yes — the underlying form عامر is Arabic.
Aamir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
